mood.summary: Surging oil prices due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are reigniting inflation fears, causing market participants to pause ahead of key US inflation data this week.

indicesNarrative: US futures are mixed to slightly lower as traders weigh surging oil prices against a backdrop of record highs. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are the primary driver, pushing yields higher and prompting a cautious stance ahead of Wednesday's CPI report.
